text:
alex: FYI — opened this thread to coordinate customer-facing followups after last night's outage. main asks: 1) schedule RCA share with customer (preferred window: next Tue/Wed), 2) final status-page text + short timeline, 3) confirm remediation actions + owners, 4) plan trust-recovery outreach. tagging folks who volunteered on the incident.

samir: timeline + quick notes: detected spike 02:12 UTC, partial routing failure to model-pool-8, mitigation at 02:27 (auto-fallback to smaller model variants), full restoration 02:40 after kube rollout. root cause appears to be a kernel-level memory leak triggered by quantized-mmap path. still validating with heap dumps.

maria: thanks. customer impacted: 3 enterprise tenants saw >= 4m error bursts; one customer (AcroHealth) had latency > 10s and some failed requests. they opened a ticket. I've pulled the incident timeline doc into the postmortem draft (link: https://redwood.internal/pm/1876543210).

jess: I can draft the status page blurb and the customer email. prefer to keep status page short and non-blamey: what went wrong (brief), what we did, whether customer action is needed (no), and next steps. will share a 2-line + expanded section.

michael: I'll own the remediation task to backport the memfix and run a canary on staging. ETA for a build and internal canary: EOD Thursday. tagging @ops-bot to create the ticket in the tracker.

ops-bot: Created ticket RW-INC-7892: "Backport quantized-mmap memory leak fix" assigned to michael, due 2026-03-19.

alex: For the customer RCA share — prefer to offer a 30-min sync for AcroHealth and an email + attached redacted RCA for others. who can present the tech part to AcroHealth? samir or michael?

samir: I can present the technical timeline and the repro specifics, but need the final heap analysis in hand. if michael is leading the fix, maybe we do pair-presenting.

maria: scheduling note — AcroHealth is in PST; on Tue/Wed next week works late-morning PST. I can coordinate calendar.

jess: Draft status page stub (candidate):

"Incident summary: Between 02:12 UTC and 02:40 UTC we experienced elevated error rates and latency for some generation requests. A kernel-level memory handling bug in a quantized I/O path caused resource exhaustion under specific traffic patterns. We mitigated impact by routing requests to a compatible model variant and deploying an emergency rollout. No customer action is required. We will share a detailed RCA with impacted customers and publish a redacted postmortem on our status site."

jess: Thoughts: replace any internal names with product-neutral phrasing. keep it <2 paragraphs.

michael: ack on the fix timeline. I'll post a canary summary to the postmortem once I have results. also will prepare a short appendix with the minimal logs we can share that don't reveal PII or internal IPs.

samir: on customer disclosure: propose two artifacts to share with AcroHealth — 1) a concise technical summary + timeline, 2) an appendix with redacted logs & mitigations. ask legal/security if anything else needs redaction.

alex: agree. @incident-bot can we get a pointer to the incident runbook steps we executed so we can list them in the RCA?

incident-bot: Incident runbook snapshot: /runbooks/model-routing/2026-03-14/steps.md 
 - 02:13: throttle rule enabled
 - 02:20: fallback to model-variant-b
 - 02:27: emergency rollout triggered
 - 02:40: validation checks passed

maria: action items so far (tracking in RW-INC-7892 & postmortem doc):
 - michael: backport + canary (due 2026-03-19)
 - jess: status page + customer email draft (due 2026-03-17)
 - samir: heap dump analysis + appendix (due 2026-03-18)
 - alex: owner for customer sync + preschedule windows (due 2026-03-16)
 - maria: update SLA impact assessment + customer list (due 2026-03-16)

jess: I'll post a customer-facing email draft here in thread later today. suggestion: keep CTO-level summary up top and technical appendix attached. also include apology + remediation steps + offer a dedicated sync.

michael: quick note re: rollback plan if canary fails — we have a hotfix rollback script: 
```
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/model-pool-8
```
Use with caution; will coordinate with oncall.

samir: please don't include internal rollout commands in customer docs obviously ;).

alex: ha. noted.

maria: scheduling: I have tentatively proposed Tue 2026-03-17 16:00 UTC (08:00 PST) and Wed 2026-03-18 17:00 UTC (09:00 PST) for AcroHealth — waiting on their preference. alex — want you as backup for the presentation.

alex: I'll be present. samir + michael to lead tech. jess you'll send the invite + materials once we confirm.

jess: first draft customer email (for quick review):

"Hi <CustomerTeam>,

We’re writing to follow up on the incident affecting inference requests on 2026-03-14. We sincerely apologize for the disruption. Our investigation found a memory handling bug in a quantized I/O path which caused a small subset of requests to fail under specific traffic. We mitigated the issue within 30 minutes and have deployed a targeted fix. No action is required on your side.

We’d like to offer a 30-minute call to walk through the technical details and answer any questions. Proposed windows: Tue 2026-03-17 08:00 PST or Wed 2026-03-18 09:00 PST. Please let us know your preference.

Regards,
Redwood Inference Support
"

jess: feedback welcome — keep tone empathetic and concise.

samir: looks good. maybe add a line about "we'll share a redacted RCA document ahead of the call".

jess: done, added that line.

maria: security/legal check: @ops-bot add RW-SEC review task for redactions.

ops-bot: Created ticket RW-SEC-203: "Review RCA redactions for customer share" assigned to security-team, due 2026-03-17.

alex: rough ETA: Once michael confirms canary and samir finalizes heap analysis, we aim to send the customer email + redacted RCA by 2026-03-16 EOD. then the call if they accept one of the windows.

jess: I'll prep the status page ready-to-publish draft and leave placeholders for the technical appendix link; we'll publish redacted postmortem after legal signoff.

samir: minor follow-up for internal owners: please add your short postmortem notes under the "contribs" section of the doc so I can assemble the final timeline.

michael: will do.

alex: thanks everyone — keeping this thread as the single source of truth for customer followups. I'll check back after calendar confirmed. :thumbsup:

jess: adding :thumbsup: and will drop drafts here.

incident-bot: Postmortem draft link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/1876543210-draft (permissions: private to incident-team).

maria: closing note — please flag any outstanding blockers. otherwise we'll reconvene for a 15-min sync Tue morning before the customer call if scheduled.

alex: closing loop — no blockers from me at the moment.

jess: no blockers.

samir: one blocker: need final heap symbols from infra team (steph) to finish analysis — pinged separately.

maria: i'll chase steph.

alex: ok, thanks all. we'll move forward on the plan above.
